answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. An agent burns a 30 POA copper-token deposit to bridge one identity to one work slot; the deposit is destroyed, never refunded. At dawn each epoch the burn repeats for reopened slots. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 POA, while each fake earns 25 POA per epoch, needing 120 epochs to break even. An honest agent pays one 30 POA burn and keeps 25 POA per epoch undiluted, so honesty stays cheaper.
